result.title: Fit-LRP: Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes for Neural Network Verification over Non-Convex Regions
result.summary: State-of-the-art neural network verifiers evaluate linear relaxations over axis-aligned bounding boxes. However, verification domains in cyber-physical systems are rarely boxes. Reachability specifications, obstacle-avoidance constraints, and neural Lyapunov certificates typically yield oblique or non-convex polyhedral regions, over which box-based bounds become extremely loose. This paper proposes Fit-LRP (Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes), a framework the implements exact optimization of affine bounds over non-convex domains (represented by unions of polytopes) by solving a sequence of small, low-dimensional linear programs. Our approach seamlessly enhances the final optimization step of LiRPA and $α,\! β$-CROWN branch-and-bound (BaB) algorithms. In BaB verification, approximating oblique constraints with axis-aligned splits causes severe combinatorial blowup and risks non-termination. By optimizing the final affine bound of a nonlinear function over the exact polyhedral state-space constraints our method eliminates box-induced over-approximations, enabling earlier search-tree pruning. On ARCH-COMP and neural Lyapunov benchmarks, Fit-LRP reduces branching on the hardest region by $47\times$, cuts worst-case verification time by $15\times$, and with region-wise partitioning, verifies on a single CPU $6.1\times$ faster than $α,\! β$-CROWN on a GPU.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Fit-LRP，将 LiRPA 与 α,β-CROWN 分支定界的最后一步仿射界优化扩展到多面体（含非凸并集）区域，用一系列小规模低维线性规划求精确界，消除 box 过近似以提前剪枝，并在 ARCH-COMP 与神经 Lyapunov 基准上大幅减少分支与验证时间。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在非凸约束域上求更紧仿射界、以更紧界驱动搜索树剪枝」的 LP 思路，可能可供核查用于对 latent 推理状态或候选推理路径做带约束的界估计与搜索剪枝；但该文属形式化验证领域，与 VLM 推理的联系需人工判断可迁移性。
